mapper.select: SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS text), true)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (id, occurred_at, tenant_id, service, title, body, app_code, route) VALUES (#{event.id}, #{event.occurredAt}, #{event.tenantId}, #{event.service}, #{event.title}, #{event.body}, #{event.link.appCode}, #{event.link.route}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO notification_recipient (notification_id, occurred_at, tenant_id, membership_id) VALUES (#{event.id}, #{event.occurredAt}, #{event.tenantId}, #{membershipId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: FROM notification n INNER JOIN notification_recipient r ON n.id = r.notification_id AND n.occurred_at = r.occurred_at AND n.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.membership_id = #{membershipId}
mapper.select:
SELECT n.id, n.service, n.title, n.body, n.app_code, n.route, n.occurred_at, r.read_at
ORDER BY n.occurred_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM notification_recipient WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId} AND read_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_recipient WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId} AND notification_id = #{id})
